mapper.select: SELECT music_idx AS musicIdx, music_title AS musicTitle, music_artist AS musicArtist, music_url AS musicUrl, music_image_url AS musicImageUrl FROM music WHERE music_idx = #{musicIdx}
SELECT music_idx, music_title, music_artist, music_url, music_image_url FROM music WHERE music_title = #{musicTitle} AND music_artist = #{musicArtist} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO music ( music_title, music_artist, music_url, music_image_url ) VALUES ( #{musicTitle}, #{musicArtist}, #{musicUrl}, #{musicImageUrl} )
